data.narrative:
Radian Forge is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $3M+. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 robotics and manufacturing peers: 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

A stage-progression method is applicable and forms the basis of valuation. Using the $3M total raised as a baseline value proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage step-ups, this method implies an $8M post-money valuation. A peer-median approach is not applicable; while the robotics sector contains 10 comparable companies, the narrow peer set filtered by same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier criteria yields fewer than three datapoints, making median comparison unreliable and potentially misleading.

The triangulated range is $6M to $9M, with a median of $8M, derived from a single method. This narrow methodological base reflects a significant constraint: insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables to validate multiples through peer analysis. Key uncertainties include the composition and growth rates of the identified peer universe, which remain underdisclosed, and the appropriateness of the 2.5x stage multiplier for this particular sector and founder profile. A more robust valuation would benefit from additional datapoints or comparable transaction multiples within robotics and manufacturing.
